output.notes: Paper's own model family PaLM 8B/62B/540B (headline 540B); block_ops attribute sizes use 8B. d_ff values derived from the stated rule d_ff = 4 x d_model (number not written literally). Vocab '256k' given as 256000; exact count not stated. Norm is LayerNorm without bias (scale only), mapped to other:. A single shared pre-LayerNorm is implied by the parallel formula LayerNorm(x) feeding both branches. A final LayerNorm before the head is not stated and is omitted. RoPE theta, pairing and fraction, attention scale and norm eps are not stated. For 540B, n_heads x head_dim (12288) differs from d_model (18432), as the table states head size is always 256.
